text_block_list.text:
Muy bien! You defeated the claw
machine!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That was hella exciting! The moment
when the
claw lifted the plushie, I swear
my heart leapt into
my mouth!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It was close, but I was so relieved when
you
managed it! Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
